notes: seat = confessional seat the winner holds; winner votes are preferential votes; list votes are valid list votes.

registered and voters per district come from the Wikipedia member list (voters = valid votes). turnout is the official published district figure from L'Orient (via Wikipedia). The two differ by more than 1 point in Mount Lebanon II (51.38 vs 54.40 computed), North II, Bekaa II and South III, and registered sums to 3,736,539 against the national 3,746,483, so treat per-district registered and voters as approximate.

Winner roster is Wikipedia list of members of the 2018-2022 Parliament (128 elected; later by-election replacements excluded). Winners listed under Mount Lebanon 5, 6 and 7 in the source belong to Mount Lebanon IV.
